player_prompt.intro:
Wo reko Slitherlink wɔ {R}x{C} grid so!
Wo dwen single continuous loop so kɔla biara a wɔde nɔma wɔ ho no nso wɔ ne bordering edges.
Toggle edges with:
  [h r c] - toggle horizontal edge a dots no akyi wɔ row r, column c
  [v r c] - toggle vertical edge a dots no nifa wɔ row r, column c
Nɔma no kyerɛ required edge count, '.' kyerɛ no constraint.
Wo wɔ {max_turns} moves sɛ wo bɛtumi asɔ puzzle no.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ɔkasa a wɔde di dwuma no fɔm no mu bɛn. De [h row col] anaa [v row col].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Edge no wɔ board no akyi.

outcome.win: Woayɛ ade biako pɛ! Wɔadi nsɛnnennen no ho dwuma!
outcome.turn_limit: Wɔaka nneɛma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no. Asɛntitiriw bi wɔ hɔ a yɛannyae mu.
